item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Samar(Paranas), #Leyte(TaclobanCity, Babatngon, LaPaz, CityOfBaybay and Javier) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Biliran(Culaba, Caibiran), #Samar(Basey, SantaRita), #NegrosOccidental(CadizCity), #EasternSamar(Dolores, CanAvid), #Leyte(Macarthur and Mayorga) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
